messages:
sara.support: Heads up — customer 'MapFlow' on the Free tier is getting a sudden flood of 429s since ~03:00 UTC. They run an overnight job and report ~60% of requests failing with 429. Asked for a temporary burst while we investigate.

evan.sre: Can you paste the raw response and any headers from their client? Also: is this all endpoints or just embeddings/generation?

sara.support: They sent this snippet:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 38
retry-after: 38
{
  "error": "rate_exceeded",
  "message": "Token throughput exceeded for plan: Free"
}
```

They say it's primarily embeddings (still single-key usage). Customer says they tried rotating API key but traffic pattern didn't change.

evan.sre: Sounds like a classic unbounded retry or client-side fanout. Ask them for client SDK version and a short traffic profile (requests/sec for last 6h). Immediate mitigations: 1) enforce exponential backoff + jitter (respect Retry-After), 2) reduce concurrency on their workers, 3) switch to batched embeddings or smaller batch sizes, 4) enable KV/prefix caching if applicable. We can also whiteboard a short soft-cap if needed.

mike.backend: FYI we shipped a fix in the SDK yesterday — there was a retry loop bug in 0.9.1 that could re-queue failed requests repeatedly on 5xx/429. The patched client is 0.9.3 (auto-jitter, maxRetries=6). If they're on 0.9.1 that's the likely culprit.

sara.support: Customer confirmed they're on sdk-js 0.9.1. They've been running tens of concurrent workers for embeddings. They asked: can we grant a temporary increase for 24h so their pipeline completes while they upgrade? They also want a sales person to discuss paid capacity.

carla.sales: We can do a short sales-assisted bridge: offer a 72h paid trial or an uplifted quota for 48h if they commit to a follow-up call. Need account email + billing contact + last 7-day usage CSV. I can open a trial order once support confirms behavior isn't malicious.

evan.sre: From infra perspective we can approve a one-time soft increase (2x) for up to 12 hours after a quick manual review. Ops needs to ensure it's not bot abuse. Also request logs: sample request IDs and client User-Agent. I'll add checks for unusual IPs/UA spikes.

sara.support: Collecting logs now. Sending sample request IDs and UA. Also pushing upgrade instructions and the quick fix snippet to customer:

```
// recommended retry/backoff
client.setRetryOptions({
  maxRetries: 6,
  backoffBaseMs: 200,
  jitter: true
});
```

deploybot: Ticket created: INC-2024-981. Soft-cap uplift applied: account mapflow@example.com quota multiplier set to 2x for 12h. Monitor alerting channel: #support-alerts. :white_check_mark:

sara.support: Thanks team — told customer to upgrade SDK to 0.9.3, implement backoff, and pause additional workers for now. Handing to carla for the trial/paid follow-up. Will attach usage CSV and request IDs to INC-2024-981. :thumbsup:
